pages.title: Xenogenome Sample
pages.text: A vial of something that is clearly a genome but is not DNA. The molecule folds the wrong way, uses letters I do not recognise and carries information more densely than any terrestrial code. It glows faintly in the dark.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I sampled a creature from another dimension expecting DNA and found something else. Life evolved under different physics, with a different chemistry of inheritance - and it was still readable.
Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Xenobiology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnicellular Genome, Silicon Life Spore, Xenobot Swarm, Xenoplasm.
